entities.name: Jesse of Kartli
entities.label: Person
entities.summary: Jesse, also known by his Muslim names Ali-Quli Khan and Mustafa Pasha,, of the Mukhranian Bagrationi dynasty, was a king (mepe) of Kartli (Georgia), acting actually as a Safavid Persian and later Ottoman viceroy (wali) from 1714 to 1716 and from 1724 until his death, respectively.
